kind: interpretation-only statistical scope clarification while fixed canonical study is running
clarification: The polynomial KID U-statistic is unbiased for population MMD under iid generated rows. The full_euler global centroid correction couples its N outputs, so that iid unbiasedness cannot be asserted for that arm. The primary estimand is the expectation of the explicitly defined finite-batch score at fixed N1000, with three independent whole-generation runs as inferential units. No per-image p-values are used. Reference-set and training-seed uncertainty are not covered.
exploratory_cross_batch_diagnostic: After all fixed jobs finish, compute generated self-kernel terms across pairs of independent seed batches, with no replacement of primary scores or new p-values. This checks per-output-marginal discrepancy without within-batch iid assumptions; only3 batches so no extra power claim.
